abstract: Abdominal and thoracic computed tomography examinations were abnormal in 23 of 57 patients (40.5%) with seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Lymph node metastases measuring less than 30 Hounsfield units (HU) occurred in 10 of these 23 patients (43.5%), five with seminoma, four with mixed germ cell tumors, and one patient with embryonal cell carcinoma. Biopsy material was obtained from low attenuation metastases in four patients. Three patients who had completed chemotherapy had evidence of extensive necrosis, but two of three had persistent tumor. In the fourth patient, a case of untreated mixed germ cell tumor, there were numerous small epithelial-lined cystic spaces. Biopsies from five patients with nodal masses measuring greater than 30 HU showed no necrosis or cystic change. There was no significant correlation between the attenuation characteristics of the metastases and clinical activity of the tumor.
abstract_ja: 精巣のセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性腫瘍の患者57例のうち23例（40.5%）で、腹部および胸部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査に異常が認められた。これらの23例のうち10例（43.5%）に、30ハウンズフィールド単位（HU）未満の低吸収性リンパ節転移が認められた。内訳は、セミノーマ5例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍4例、胎児性癌1例であった。低吸収性転移の4例で生検材料が採取された。化学療法を完了した3例では広範な壊死が認められ、そのうち2例では腫瘍が残存していた。未治療の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の1例では、上皮で覆われた小さな嚢胞性空間が多数認められた。30HUを超えるリンパ節腫瘤の5例の生検では、壊死や嚢胞性変化は認められなかった。転移病変のCT値と腫瘍の臨床的活動性との間に有意な相関は認められなかった。
